55. Counting Distinct Pairs

50

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Given an array A of N elements, count the number of distinct pairs (i,j) such that i < j and A[i] < A[j].If no such pairs can be made print -1
input_spec: The input consists of an integer N, representing the number of elements, followed by N space-separated integers representing the elements of array A.
output_spec: The output is a single integer representing the count of distinct pairs (i,j) such that i < j and A[i] < A[j]. If no such pairs can be made, print -1.
